title: A signal between meals
hook: Connect a hormonal signal with a target.

knows: Hormones can carry signals through the blood to target tissues.
doesNotKnow: Glucagon released by pancreatic alpha cells promotes liver glucose output, including through glycogen breakdown and glucose production.

misconception: All hormones come from one gland and act on every cell.
objective: Identify the stated endocrine signal and its target in a simplified pathway.

claims.text: Question, diagram and explanation: Which hormone from pancreatic alpha cells promotes glucose release by the liver? Glucagon released by pancreatic alpha cells promotes liver glucose output, including through glycogen breakdown and glucose production.
The diagram shows one selected source–target pathway, not all hormone effects or feedback loops.

Recall: In the stated example, which source releases Glucagon into the circulation? Glucagon released by pancreatic alpha cells promotes liver glucose output, including through glycogen breakdown and glucose production.
